snippet.title: Helenland Teaser
snippet.description:
Helenland Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4283850
Helenland Homepage: https://www.kiliasgames.com/helenland

FREE DEMO is AVAILABLE on Steam.

Game Description:

Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it.
But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

Helenland is a single-player, first-person psychological horror.
The game features deep narrative, exploration and puzzles.

Open the door to Helenland. Embrace fear and madness.

Notice: A link to the list of third‑party assets presented in the teaser is available on the Helenland Homepage and Steam page.
